Recipes.impactShared: It is shared with {count, plural, one {# other Home} other {# other Homes}}. Deleting removes it there too:
Recipes.impactUnshareInstead: Remove it from one Home instead
Recipes.impactNotShared: It is not shared with any other Home.
Recipes.impactFavorites: It is marked as a favorite {count, plural, one {# time} other {# times}}.
Recipes.impactNoFavorites: Nobody has marked it as a favorite.
Recipes.impactBeingEdited: Someone is editing it right now. You can delete it when they are done.
Recipes.impactTrash: It goes to the trash for 7 days. If you restore it, its shares stay paused until you turn each one back on.
Recipes.cannotShare: Only people who manage recipes where this recipe lives can share it.
Recipes.shareExplainer: Sharing never makes a copy: every Home sees the same recipe, and changes show everywhere. You can only share with Homes you belong to.
Recipes.sharedWithNone: This recipe is not shared with any other Home.
Recipes.sharePaused: Paused since the recipe was deleted. Nobody there sees it until you turn it back on.
Recipes.shareCanEdit: Recipe managers there may edit it
Recipes.removeShareBody: Nobody in that Home will see the recipe any more, favorites of it there are removed and anyone there editing it is stopped. The recipe itself stays here.
Recipes.viewOnlyBody: Recipe managers of that Home can no longer edit it, and anyone there editing it now is stopped. They can still see, rate and favorite it.
Recipes.shareNoHomes: There is no other Home of yours to share it with.
Recipes.shareAllowEditLabel: Let recipe managers of that Home edit it
Recipes.shareAllowEditHelp: Otherwise everyone there can view, rate and favorite it, but not change it.
Recipes.shareConsequenceAudience: Everyone in {home} can see it, now and as members join.
Recipes.shareConsequenceEdit: Recipe managers of that Home can change it.
Recipes.shareConsequenceSync: It stays one recipe: any saved change shows everywhere it is shared.
Recipes.shareConsequenceNoOnward: Nobody there can share it further or delete it.
Recipes.importIntro: Paste the address of a recipe page. Madeora reads the recipe on that page so you can check and change it before saving. Nothing is saved until you choose to.
Recipes.importDestinationHelp: Choose first where the recipe is for. Importing never shares it anywhere else.
Recipes.importUrlHelp: A public page starting with https:// or http://.
Recipes.importReasonInvalidUrl: That is not a web address Madeora can open. Use a public address starting with https:// or http://.
Recipes.importReasonBlocked: Madeora does not open that address: it points to a private or local network.
Recipes.importReasonUnreachable: The page could not be reached.
Recipes.importReasonTimeout: The page took too long to answer.
Recipes.importReasonTooLarge: The page is too large to read.
Recipes.importReasonNotHtml: That address is not a web page.
Recipes.importReasonRestricted: The page needs a sign-in or subscription. Madeora does not get around that.
Recipes.importReasonNotFound: The page does not exist (any more).
Recipes.importReasonNoRecipe: Madeora found no recipe details on that page. Not every website describes its recipes in a way that can be read.
Recipes.importReviewIntro: This is what the page says. Correct, remove, reorder or add anything before you save. It is not saved yet.
Recipes.importWarningNoServings: The page does not say how many servings it makes.
Recipes.importWarningAmbiguousServings: The number of servings is unclear (for example a range), so it was left empty.
Recipes.importWarningAsWritten: Some ingredient lines were kept as written, without a quantity: check their amounts and units.
Recipes.importWarningShortened: Some text was longer than Madeora allows and was shortened.
Recipes.importWarningTooMany: The page lists more ingredients or steps than a recipe can hold; the rest was left out.
Recipes.importWarningTime: A preparation or cooking time was longer than seven days and was left empty.
Recipes.importWarningPhoto: The page has a photo. Madeora does not copy photos from websites; you can add your own cover.

RecipeWidgets.failed: Something went wrong. Try again later.
RecipeWidgets.emptyFavorites: Mark recipes as favorites to see them here.
RecipeWidgets.emptyRecent: Recipes added here appear in this widget.
RecipeWidgets.emptyTopRated: Recipes appear here once someone rates them.
